grammarFocus: much / many / a little / a few；数量表达；should / should not。
title: Week 11 Listening: Food Choices and Daily Habits
instructions: 这是一份模拟英语听力练习材料（非官方雅思测试）。请先听录音（或阅读录音稿），然后完成10道题。题目类型包括单选、填空和判断正误/未提及。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定字数。所有解释均为中文，并附有原文证据。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. You look tired. Are you okay?
Ben: Yeah, I'm fine. I just didn't sleep well. I have too much work this week.
Mia: That's not good. You should take a break. How many hours do you work every day?
Ben: About ten hours. I know I should not work so much. But I have many things to do.
Mia: Do you have time to eat lunch?
Ben: Not really. I usually eat a little bread and drink a little coffee. Sometimes I have a few biscuits.
Mia: That's not healthy. You should eat more vegetables and fruit. You should not eat only bread.
Ben: I know. But I don't have much time to cook. I have a few minutes in the morning, so I just make toast.
Mia: You can prepare food the night before. I make a little salad and put it in the fridge. Then I have a few healthy snacks for the day.
Ben: That's a good idea. How much water do you drink?
Mia: I drink a lot of water. Maybe two litres a day. You should drink more water, too.
Ben: You're right. I drink a little water, maybe one glass. I should drink more.
Mia: And you should not drink so much coffee. How many cups do you have?
Ben: I have three or four cups. I know it's too many.
Mia: Try to have a few cups, not four. And you should eat a little fruit in the afternoon.
Ben: Okay. I'll try. Thanks for the advice.
Mia: No problem. Let's get lunch together tomorrow. We can have a lot of vegetables.
Ben: Sounds good. I should make better choices.

questions.prompt: How many hours does Ben work every day?
questions.explanation: Ben 说“About ten hours.”，所以每天工作大约十小时。

questions.prompt: What does Ben usually eat for lunch?
options: A little bread and a little coffee
answers: A little bread and a little coffee
questions.explanation: Ben 说“I usually eat a little bread and drink a little coffee.”，所以午餐通常只吃一点面包、喝一点咖啡。
questions.evidence: Ben: Not really. I usually eat a little bread and drink a little coffee.

questions.prompt: Mia says Ben should eat more ______ and fruit. (one word)
questions.explanation: Mia 说“You should eat more vegetables and fruit.”，所以填 vegetables。
questions.evidence: Mia: That's not healthy. You should eat more vegetables and fruit.

questions.prompt: How much water does Mia drink a day?
questions.explanation: Mia 说“Maybe two litres a day.”，所以每天大约喝两升水。
questions.evidence: Mia: I drink a lot of water. Maybe two litres a day.

questions.prompt: How many cups of coffee does Ben have?
questions.explanation: Ben 说“I have three or four cups.”，所以喝三到四杯咖啡。
questions.evidence: Ben: I have three or four cups. I know it's too many.

questions.prompt: What does Mia suggest Ben should do about coffee?
options: Drink a few cups, not four
answers: Drink a few cups, not four
questions.explanation: Mia 说“Try to have a few cups, not four.”，建议喝几杯，而不是四杯。
questions.evidence: Mia: Try to have a few cups, not four.

questions.prompt: According to Mia, what should Ben do the night before?
questions.explanation: Mia 说“You can prepare food the night before.”，建议 Ben 前一晚准备好食物。
questions.evidence: Mia: You can prepare food the night before.

questions.prompt: What does Mia say about her salad?
options: She makes a little salad and puts it in the fridge
She buys a big salad every day
answers: She makes a little salad and puts it in the fridge
questions.explanation: Mia 说“I make a little salad and put it in the fridge.”，所以选第一项。
questions.evidence: Mia: I make a little salad and put it in the fridge.

questions.prompt: Ben says he drinks a little water. What does Mia say he should do?
questions.explanation: Mia 说“You should drink more water, too.”，建议 Ben 多喝水。
questions.evidence: Mia: You should drink more water, too.

questions.prompt: What will Mia and Ben do tomorrow?
questions.explanation: Mia 说“Let's get lunch together tomorrow.”，所以明天一起吃午饭。
questions.evidence: Mia: No problem. Let's get lunch together tomorrow.

grammar.title: much / many / a little / a few；数量表达；should / should not
grammar.explanation: much 用于不可数名词（如 water, coffee, time），many 用于可数名词复数（如 hours, cups, things）。a little 表示“一点”，用于不可数名词；a few 表示“几个”，用于可数名词复数。should 表示“应该”，should not 表示“不应该”。
grammar.example: You should not drink so much coffee. / I have a few minutes in the morning.

questions.explanation: books 是可数名词复数，应该用 many。much 和 a little 不能修饰可数名词复数。

options: There is a few water in the bottle.
There is a little water in the bottle.
There are a little water in the bottle.
answers: There is a little water in the bottle.
questions.explanation: water 是不可数名词，应该用 a little，且谓语用 is。a few 修饰可数名词复数，are 与不可数名词不搭配。
questions.evidence: There is a little water in the bottle.

options: You should to eat more fruit.
questions.explanation: should 后面直接跟动词原形，不加 to，也不用 -ing 形式。

options: He should not drinks so much coffee.
He should not drink so much coffee.
He should not drinking so much coffee.
answers: He should not drink so much coffee.
questions.explanation: should not 后面跟动词原形 drink，不能加 -s 或 -ing。
questions.evidence: He should not drink so much coffee.
